title: Molecular Insights into Conformational Heterogeneity and Enhanced Structural Integrity of Helicobacter pylori DNA Binding Protein Hup at Low pH.
authors: Agarwal, Nipanshu; Jaiswal, Nancy; Gulati, Khushboo; Gangele, Krishnakant; Nagar, Nupur; Kumar, Dinesh; Poluri, Krishna Mohan
one_liner_zh: 该文结合NMR与分子动力学模拟研究幽门螺杆菌DNA结合蛋白Hup在低pH下的构象异质性与结构稳定性，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The summarized amalgam of internal relaxation modulations and external forces like pH, temperature, and solvent conditions determine the protein structure, stability, and function. In a free-energy landscape, although conformers are arranged in vertical hierarchy, there exist several adjacent parallel sets with conformers occupying equivalent energy cleft. Such conformational states are pre-requisites for the functioning of proteins that have oscillating environmental conditions. As these conformational changes have utterly small re-arrangements, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is unique in elucidating the structure-dynamics-stability-function relationships for such conformations. Helicobacter pylori survives and causes gastric cancer at extremely low pH also. However, least is known as to how the genome of the pathogen is protected from reactive oxygen species (ROS) scavenging in the gut at low pH under acidic stress. In the current study, biophysical characteristics of H. pylori DNA binding protein (Hup) have been elucidated at pH 2 using a combination of circular dichroism, fluorescence, NMR spectroscopy, and molecular dynamics simulations. Interestingly, the protein was found to have conserved structural features, differential backbone dynamics, enhanced stability, and DNA binding ability at low pH as well. In summary, the study suggests the partaking of Hup protein even at low pH in DNA protection for maintaining the genome integrity.
abstract_zh: 内部弛豫调节与外部力量（如pH、温度、溶剂条件）的综合作用决定了蛋白质的结构、稳定性和功能。在自由能景观中，尽管构象体按垂直层级排列，但存在若干相邻的平行集合，其中构象体占据等效的能量裂隙。此类构象状态是功能蛋白质在环境条件波动下的前提。由于这些构象变化涉及极其微小的重排，核磁共振（NMR）波谱法在阐明此类构象的结构-动力学-稳定性-功能关系方面具有独特性。幽门螺杆菌（Helicobacter pylori）在极低pH下也能存活并导致胃癌，然而，关于该病原体基因组在低pH酸性应激下如何免受肠道中活性氧（ROS）清除的机制知之甚少。在本研究中，通过结合圆二色光谱、荧光光谱、核磁共振波谱和分子动力学模拟，在pH 2条件下阐明了H. pylori DNA结合蛋白（Hup）的生物物理特性。有趣的是，该蛋白质在低pH下仍保持保守的结构特征、差异化的骨架动力学、增强的稳定性及DNA结合能力。总之，该研究表明Hup蛋白即使在低pH下也参与DNA保护，以维持基因组完整性。
